recruit.brief: I built a test hill as steep as the climbs at Neon Peaks. Your car starts with 4:1 gears. Pick a gear, predict, then drive it.
recruit.question: Will your car make it to the top?

cadet.brief: I built a very steep hill. Pick a gear. Will the car get to the top?
cadet.question: Will the car get to the top?

operative.brief: I built a 40 m test hill at 21.8°, as steep as the climbs at Neon Peaks. The car starts at 4:1. Choose a gear ratio, predict, then drive it.
operative.question: Will your car reach the top?
